overview_description.description: Mage Legal provides AI-powered legal diligence and contract review software focused on transactional work. The platform connects to virtual data rooms, classifies documents, and extracts structured terms across hundreds of contracts. It flags issues against predefined risk checks, supports gap analysis and document request tracking, and generates firm-branded diligence memos. Mage Legal offers tools for disclosure schedule preparation, closing checklists, and variance detection across agreement sets. It also includes contract redline comparison, questionnaire generation, and multi-language document analysis to support M&A, financing, and capital markets matters.
